message: Some languages look like birds. Those are fusional languages.
Others look like cats, they are isolating.
Yet others look like fish, those would be agglutinative.
Languages with evidentiality aspect have big eyes.
Those with many phonemes also have many teeth.
Shape of teeth tells how many consonants they can cluster together.
Those with declension have a big moustache.
Those with lot of genders have lot of eyebrows
Tonal languages have stripes on the tongue
And there's another kind of stripes for pitch accent
Our team was working hard on visualizing all that
It took us a lot of time to deploy it
So now at least enjoy it
